aboutGame.title: What is On Thin Ice?
paragraphs: On Thin Ice is a point-and-click detective mystery from Haiku Games and an entry in the long-running Adventure Escape Mysteries series. Players take the role of Detective Kate Gray alongside her partner Murphy, whose sushi dinner is cut short when a ransomware gang cripples the precinct and a blizzard seals off the city.

Across the case you search frozen crime scenes, repair sabotaged electronics, and crack layered ciphers by combining items and cross-referencing clues found in other rooms. This On Thin Ice Wiki collects every walkthrough, puzzle solution, and code so you can finish the investigation without spending a single hint star.

modules.name: On Thin Ice Wiki Beginner Guide
modules.description: This module explains the basic gameplay loop, how item combination works, and the first steps every new player should take in Chapter 1.

highlights.detail: Start at the precinct and clear the ransomware terminal to open up the investigation.
Tap every hotspot with the magnifier so no clue is missed before you leave a scene.
Pick up items as soon as they appear; Kate's inventory is the key to every locked door.
Combine related items in the inventory bar to build tools the game never hands you directly.
Read the visitor rules, notes, and posters closely; most codes are written into the environment.
Save your hint stars for late-case puzzles and follow our walkthrough when you get stuck.

items.question: What is On Thin Ice?
items.answer: On Thin Ice is a point-and-click detective mystery from Haiku Games and part of the Adventure Escape Mysteries series, starring Detective Kate Gray and her partner Murphy as they race a ransomware gang through a blizzard.

items.question: Which chapter should I start with?
items.answer: Start with Chapter 1 at the precinct, then follow the trail to Hacksaw's cabin. Our On Thin Ice Wiki walkthrough covers every chapter in order so you always know the next step.

items.question: Where do I find On Thin Ice codes?
items.answer: The Codes module lists every keypad and safe solution, including the 9416 floorboard safe and the 40242 detention locker, along with the clue logic behind each answer.

items.question: Can I play On Thin Ice for free?
items.answer: Yes. Adventure Escape Mysteries titles, including On Thin Ice, are free to play on mobile, with optional hint purchases if you would rather not solve a puzzle yourself.

items.question: What should I do if I get stuck in On Thin Ice?
items.answer: Check the puzzle guide and walkthrough pages first; they break down sliding tiles, circuit boards, and ciphers step by step so you can keep your hint stars for later.
